main_section:
Join Our Community of Design & Technology Educators

Everyone Can Make is built on a simple belief: anyone can learn to design, build, and create — given the right guidance. We're looking for educators to bring that belief to life across electronics, digital fabrication, design, software, and mechanical engineering.

Join the Community

Why teach with us

Work with motivated students and schools, set your own availability, and get paid per session or by the hour.

What we offer

Access to fully equipped labs, teaching materials, and a platform that handles scheduling and bookings for you.

Who we're looking for

Design & Technology educators and practitioners with hands-on expertise in any of our skill domains, at any experience level, who believe everyone can make.

Join the Community
